topic: Myth: mining one bitcoin takes ten minutes
title: Myth: Mining 1 Bitcoin Takes 10 Minutes
hook: Myth: it takes ten minutes to mine one bitcoin.

scenes.narration: The network aims for a block about every ten minutes.
That block pays the subsidy, three point one two five bitcoin, plus fees, to one winner.
Your chance of winning a block is your share of total hashrate.

cta: Did you believe it? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Ten minutes is the network's block time, not the time it takes you to mine a coin.
